datasets.name: Danish Dynaword
datasets.count_basis: Exact published descriptive_stats.json values; source-to-domain mapping from the dataset card at the same pinned revision.
notes: Records are published rows. Sources use different document and segment lengths, so record counts do not measure the same text volume across languages.
Domain labels are the publisher's source classifications, preserved without merging categories such as Spoken, Conversation, and Speeches.
Sources and domain totals exactly match the published corpus record and token totals.
These are release statistics, not a statement that this website indexes every language.
Annotation coverage is the published number of rows with machine-generated metadata from ellamind/propella-1-4b. It is not human annotation, human validation, or a guarantee of quality or privacy.
6 sources have no published annotation coverage count; their coverage remains unknown. Root coverage is retained.
The published comparison release is v1.2.27. The record explorer currently indexes the earlier v1.2.23 snapshot: 7,399,685 records, 9,813,858,821 tokens, and 50 sources.
